Screen Time engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple's Screen Time stack covers storefront language. Developer portal, entitlements, and Connect actually separate usage-enforcement behavior from product-page copy:

  • FamilyControls authorization — parent/guardian approval flows for managed child accounts. Controls who can configure limits. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • DeviceActivity monitoring — usage monitoring extensions and report generation in the binary. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains usage tracking to buyers.
  • ManagedSettings shields — app and website blocking configuration at the OS level. Your listing may mention App Limits; wiring shield APIs is engineering work, not listing copy.
  • Screen Time API & entitlements — FamilyControls capability, DeviceActivityReport extensions, and ManagedSettingsStore in code. Configuring enforcement is engineering — AppLocale does not touch it.
  • In-app usage dashboards — charts, streaks, and report UI your team built. Screen Time listing copy markets those surfaces on the product page; SwiftUI chart code is separate.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Screen Time capability flags in the binary.

A working Screen Time integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Screen Time, App Limits, Downtime, and usage reports on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you implement FamilyControls or DeviceActivity in code.

Screen Time-specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Usage-management listings use terms general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Screen Time features — not a literal paste of US marketing:

屏幕使用时间 (Screen Time) vs App 限额 (App Limits)

Apple's Chinese system UI uses 屏幕使用时间 for the Screen Time settings pane and ecosystem. App 限额 or 应用限额 fits when your marketing emphasizes per-app time caps — daily limits on social apps, games, or categories. Pick the term buyers recognize on each screenshot frame — a weekly report card needs 屏幕使用时间-friendly phrasing; an App Limits slider frame may use App 限额 when accurate.

停用时间 (Downtime) and usage reports

US pages use Downtime for scheduled offline windows and Screen Time reports for weekly or daily usage summaries. Chinese App Store copy commonly uses 停用时间 for Downtime and 使用时间报告 or 屏幕使用时间报告 for usage reports when your app or dashboard actually surfaces those views. Do not promise FamilyControls-managed Downtime in listing copy if your product only shows passive usage charts without enforcement.

Parental controls vs digital wellbeing positioning

Some apps market parental controls (家长控制) for family-managed child devices; others market personal digital wellbeing (数字健康) for self-managed limits. zh-Hans copy should match your actual audience — family dashboard vs solo tracker — without mixing Kids category compliance language into a general wellbeing app.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Screen Time-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 屏幕使用时间, App 限额, 停用时间, and 家长控制 each signal different intent from generic productivity or Focus mode keywords.

Common mistakes on Screen Time–themed zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming Screen Time integration localizes automatically — FamilyControls authorized in the app; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Screen Time screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating Screen Time with Focus Filters — listing says "Focus mode profiles" when the product story is App Limits and Downtime, not notification silencing
  • Promising system Screen Time replacement — zh-Hans copy implies your app replaces iOS Settings Screen Time when Connect and your binary support only a companion dashboard
  • English App Limits on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in badges on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Mixing Kids category vocabulary into wellbeing apps — "Made for Kids" phrasing on a general parental-control app that is not Kids-category rated
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement DeviceActivity extensions — Screen Time API engineering and ManagedSettings configuration are outside listing rewrite scope
  • What's New still English after Screen Time launch — see What's New in Simplified Chinese when usage features shipped in a recent version
